dependency_classes.THIRD_PARTY: External provider, hosted platform, vendor credential, SaaS quota, external scheduler, or other non-StegVerse service. Never a terminal blocker; worker must pursue another solution or workaround.
dependency_classes.INTERNAL_CAPABILITY: Missing StegVerse-owned capability or implementation. May be BLOCKED only with an executable solution/workaround plan.
dependency_classes.AUTHORITY: Missing admitted authority. May be BLOCKED only with a machine-observable authority-resolution path and workaround candidates that preserve authority boundaries.
dependency_classes.PHYSICAL_RESOURCE: Required StegVerse-owned/federated hardware or runtime resource does not yet exist. May be BLOCKED only while actively pursuing an alternate eligible resource or construction path.
dependency_classes.SAFETY_POLICY: Fail-closed safety or governance boundary. May remain blocked; bypass is forbidden, but a compliant alternate solution must still be named when one exists.

invariant: A blocker is a demand for a different solution. A third-party dependency is never the reason StegVerse stops progressing.
